ablation_behavior_off: Set η=0 or all u_i=0 while retaining identical Poincare maps, distance, codebooks, schedules, seeds, and parameter count; confirms the branch signal contributes beyond curved quantization.
ablation_both_on: Use train-only successor covariance directions, support weights, Mobius residual transport, and Poincare nearest-code assignment; export resulting SIDs and evaluate Stage3 test Recall@10 once under the locked protocol.
ablation_geometry_off: Replace exp/log, Mobius addition and geodesic distance with Euclidean q_i^ℓ=P r_i^ℓ+ηb_iPu_i and squared Euclidean nearest-code assignment, with matched dimension, η, codebook size, and training schedule.
behavior_computation: From training-split user sequences only, for every adjacent pair (i,j) collect frozen Stage1 e_j grouped by source item i; compute n_i, mean μ_i and a shrinkage covariance Σ_i=(S_i+λI)/(n_i+λ), where S_i is the centered sum of outer products. Take its leading eigenvector u_i; if n_i<3 or the leading eigengap is below ε, set u_i=0. Keep the training-only arrays fixed for all epochs.
behavior_signal: User-interest branching: dispersion of the next-item embedding contexts after a given item across distinct training users, rather than raw successor frequency alone.
cost_estimate: One preprocessing pass over training adjacencies and successor Stage1 vectors: O(E d_e + M d_e²) in a streaming covariance implementation, where E is training adjacency count and M=24,556 items; retain one d_e mean and low-rank branch direction per item. At frozen scale, 24,556 × 24 × 3,000 = 1,768,032,000 item-stage evaluations if every item is visited at each of 24 steps/epoch; practical minibatch work is proportional to actual sampled items. Runtime overhead is one exp/log/Mobius map per sampled item and stage plus the existing O(B K d) distance search, estimated 10–25% tokenizer-step overhead; Stage3 inference overhead is none.
coupling_equation: q_i^ℓ = exp_0^c(P r_i^ℓ) ⊕_c exp_0^c(η b_i P u_i); k_i^ℓ = argmin_k d_c(q_i^ℓ, exp_0^c(code_k^ℓ))². Here b_i u_i is the named training-behavior branch term and exp_0^c, ⊕_c, d_c are the explicit curved operations.
coupling_path: Training-user successor dispersion yields u_i and support b_i; the curved map turns ηb_iPu_i into a Poincare point that is Mobius-added to the current mapped residual, changing the very point whose geodesic nearest code defines that SID digit.
falsifiable_hypothesis: It is worth keeping only if the training users' successor-context dispersion contains repeatable branch directions not already captured by the item text embedding. Observe a changed but stable per-level SID assignment distribution and improved Stage3 test Recall@10, targeting >0.065; check held-out-from-training-user transition predictability only as a diagnostic, not for SID construction or tuning.
hyperbolic_location: In each RQ-VAE residual stage immediately before hard code selection, transport the mapped residual by Mobius-adding a mapped, behavior-derived branch tangent; perform code selection by Poincare geodesic distance and decode the selected point with log_0^c for residual subtraction.
hyperbolic_operator: Poincare-ball exponential/logarithmic maps at origin, Mobius addition, and geodesic distance with constant negative curvature -c (c>0).
key_change: At each residual quantization stage, compute the item-specific branch vector from its train-only successor-context covariance, map the residual and branch vector to the origin tangent space of a negatively curved Poincare ball, and add a bounded branch-directed tangent displacement before the curved nearest-code decision. The displacement modifies the actual point being quantized, so either removing behavior or replacing the curved map changes assignments.
leakage_boundary: Build the statistics exclusively from the canonical training interaction parquet after applying its train split; never read validation/test rows, targets, or user histories. Stage1 item text embeddings are the frozen pre-existing item features. Generate SIDs for all catalog items by lookup, using zero branch vector for items without a training successor; validation/test are used only in the separately governed Stage3 evaluation.
motivation: A single item embedding may sit at the junction of distinct user intents (for example, users who consume it as a lead-in to different follow-up categories). An isotropic RQ residual can merge these branches even though their future-use contexts differ.
novelty: Existing repository mechanisms already use transition-conditioned code scoring, Poincare residual quantization, and successor-branch candidate assignments. This instead derives a per-item branching direction from the dispersion of each training user's next-item contexts and applies it as a tangent-space residual transport before quantization; it is not a code-role transition score or a standalone geometry loss.
observables: Log per-stage code indices, assignment churn against baseline, distance margins between the best two codes, and downstream Stage3 test Recall@10. With coupling on, branch-heavy items should change assignment more than low-branch items, and their SID prefixes should better predict training-user successor-context branch membership; final success is test Recall@10 >0.065 without test-informed SID changes.
risks: Successor covariance can be noisy for low-support items, top eigenvectors can be unstable or nearly isotropic, and branch displacement may damage semantic reconstruction or overfit frequent users. Capping b_i, shrinkage, a small η, and reporting support-stratified assignment churn mitigate these risks.
safeguards: Compute statistics in float64 or streaming covariance; eigengap/support gate and zero-vector fallback for unsupported items; normalize eigenvectors with deterministic sign; clamp norms to (1−ε)/√c before ball operations, clamp atanh inputs to 1−ε, use stable small-norm series for exp/log, constrain η and P spectral norm, use float32 minimum for distance accumulation, and assert all outputs finite. Tune η and shrinkage on training-only diagnostics or validation under the project's prescribed model-selection protocol, never on test Recall.
spec_equations: For each training adjacency i→j, accumulate μ_i=Σe_j/n_i and S_i=Σ(e_j−μ_i)(e_j−μ_i)^T; Σ_i=(S_i+λI)/(n_i+λ). Let u_i be the principal unit eigenvector when support/eigengap passes thresholds, otherwise 0; b_i=min(1,log(1+n_i)/log(1+n_95)). For each level: x=exp_0^c(P r); a=exp_0^c(η b_i P u_i); q=x⊕_c a; k*=argmin_k d_c(q,exp_0^c(c_k))²; v=log_0^c(exp_0^c(c_k*)); r←r−v. Use baseline straight-through quantized forward path and losses. Poincare formulas: exp_0^c(v)=tanh(√c||v||)v/(√c||v||); x⊕_c y=((1+2c<x,y>+c||y||²)x+(1−c||x||²)y)/(1+2c<x,y>+c²||x||²||y||²); d_c(x,y)=2/√c atanh(√c||−x⊕_c y||); log_0^c(x)=atanh(√c||x||)x/(√c||x||).
spec_inputs_outputs: Inputs: canonical training user sequences, frozen item embeddings e_i, stage residual r_i^ℓ, learned projection P, codebooks, c, η, and shrinkage/support thresholds. Outputs: fixed per-item (u_i,b_i) training-only branch statistics and per-level hard code index k_i^ℓ; exported ordered code indices form each item's SID.

specification.text: Let sequences be the ordered user interactions in the training split only. For item i, collect successor items j from adjacent training events, embed each j using frozen Stage1 vector e_j, and compute μ_i and covariance Σ_i over those vectors; define b_i=min(1, log(1+n_i)/log(1+n_95)) and let u_i be the unit top eigenvector of Σ_i, with sign fixed by positive dot product with the mean successor vector. For level ℓ with Euclidean residual r_i^ℓ, map x_i^ℓ=exp_0^c(P r_i^ℓ) and a_i=exp_0^c(η b_i P u_i), where P is a learned low-rank projection into dimension d and c>0 is fixed. Form the target q_i^ℓ=x_i^ℓ ⊕_c a_i (Mobius addition), select k*=argmin_k d_c(q_i^ℓ, exp_0^c(code^ℓ_k))², and map selected code back with log_0^c before baseline Euclidean residual subtraction. Train with baseline reconstruction/codebook/commitment losses through the straight-through assignment. Freeze branch statistics before RQ-VAE training.

title: Route user-interest branches into hyperbolic residual updates
